name: otp-email-service
description: Django microservice for email OTP verification, password recovery, and SMTP notifications, deployed on Vercel

paragraphs: A standalone Django REST microservice that handles email OTP verification, password recovery, and notification emails. It runs separately from the main API and is designed to be deployed on Vercel (serverless), so OTP emails never wait on a sleeping free-tier server.

Serverless note: Vercel functions don't share memory between requests. The default LocMemCache used for OTP storage works locally and on a single long-running server (Render), but on Vercel you should store OTPs in a shared place, such as the database or a Redis cache (for example Upstash). See Deployment on Vercel.
features: No cold-start delay for OTP: the main API runs on a free tier that sleeps when idle. Verification emails need to go out immediately, so this service runs as a serverless function on Vercel instead.
Independent scaling and failure: if the main API is down or waking up, signup and password reset still work.
Clear separation: email credentials and authentication logic live in one small codebase.
Issues 6-digit OTP codes by email using HTML templates (emails/otpverification.html)
Stages the new user temporarily, valid for 10 minutes
